heading: 2.10 Multi-omic Integration of Histopathology Image Analysis
text:
Description: working group addresses need standardized workflows
integrate histopathology image-derived features genomic 
transcriptomic analyses R/Bioconductor. develop data structures 
workflows processing image analysis outputs, create curated repository
TCGA image features, provide comprehensive training resources. Initial
goals: next two years, plan establish standardized workflows 
importing image features Python-based tools R/Bioconductor data
structures, process TCGA histopathology images create curated repository
extracted features, develop educational materials documentation 
integrated image-omic analysis.Leads: Sehyun OhCurrent Members: Mohamed Omar, Ilaria Billato, Hervé Pagès, Levi Waldron,
Davide Risso, Chiara Romualdi, Luigi Marchionni, Marcel Ramos, Sean Davis,
Lucio QueirozZulip: #histopathology-image-anlyasis
